messages:
Anika: Heads up — HelioHealth showing a ~38% drop in API token usage over the last 30 days and their procurement contact changed. Saw a note that they're evaluating a competitor for latency/cost. Marking this as high renewal risk, need quick triage.
Marcos: Can you paste the last 30d usage chart link? I want to confirm which routes dropped (embed vs gen).
Anika: Here: https://app.redwood/metrics/heliohealth/usage?range=30d — gen traffic down the most, embeddings steady. Renewal date is 2026-05-15 per CRM.
Ryan: I can run a 30-min targeted enablement about cost controls (batching, caching) + a small demo of our quantization recommendations. Happy to do next week. Which stakeholders should we invite?
Anika: New contact is "Jordan Park" (Director of ML Ops). Previous champion (Maya) stepped back. Jordan's been asking about SSD vs GPU latency and a cheaper managed alternative.
Priya: Let's apply the account-risk playbook: 1) Quick owner reachout 2) Technical enablement w/ SE 3) Exec sponsorship check 4) Competitive feature/price check. I can take owner reachout tomorrow.
Elena: Pulled a quick snapshot:
```
metric,30d_change
requests_total,-37.9%
generation_requests,-48.3%
embedding_requests,-2.1%
avg_latency_gen,+12ms
errors_5xx,0.4%
```
Looks like gen-specific pipeline is the issue.
Marcos: @Ryan, can you run a perf comparison script against their sample model workload? If we can show latency parity at similar cost or better, that helps.
Ryan: Yep — need their sample prompt set and concurrency profile. Anika, can you ask Jordan for a short workload dump or share a sanitized prompt list?
Anika: Reached out to Jordan via email and included a calendar link for a 30-min session. Also asked for their perf trace and cost targets.
ops-bot: Reminder — HelioHealth renewal in 51 days (2026-05-15). Renewal owner: Priya.
Priya: Scheduling: I'll do owner check-in Mon, Ryan schedule SE session Tue/Wed, Marcos to prepare model-level perf analysis. We'll capture objections and track in the win-risk doc.
Marcos: One more ask — can Product confirm if the new cheaper variant still supports their required function-calling hooks? Jordan mentioned function-call reliability is a blocker.
Ryan: If product OKs parity, I can include a short walkthrough showing function-calling and fallback policies.
Anika: Thanks team. I'll update the renewal tracker and tag Jordan's stakeholders. If we don't get the workload dump by EOD Friday, escalate to AE. :eyes:
